MAPPLET.DESCRIPTION:
This mapplet Standardize Individual Member Name
[JC-IPS 7/27/2020] Added Source full name with no transformations [ML 11/6/2020] Added prefix / suffix source and exception codes to output [ML 11/22/2024] Added tab to the junk character list for all cleanse functions [ML 02/20/2025] Added lookup to a list if junk names (trear junk names as null) [ML 03/05/2025] Updated the Junk Name match to use trimmed upper case
MAPPLET.NAME: mplt_Name_Standardization_Indv_Member

TRANSFORMFIELD.NAME: Exception_Code
TRANSFORMFIELD.EXPRESSION: IIF( NOT ISNULL(Src_Suffix) and ltrim(rtrim(Src_Suffix))<>'' and ISNULL(std_Suffix) ,'Invalid_Suffix',null)

TRANSFORMFIELD.NAME: Exception_Code
TRANSFORMFIELD.EXPRESSION: IIF( NOT ISNULL(Src_Prefix) and ltrim(rtrim(Src_Prefix))<>'' and ISNULL(std_Prefix) ,'Invalid_Prefix',null)

TRANSFORMATION.DESCRIPTION: IDQ Token Standardizer std_Remove_Junk_Char_Indv rebuilt as an Expression.
TRANSFORMATION.NAME: std_Remove_Junk_Char_Indv

TRANSFORMATION.DESCRIPTION: IDQ Case Converter cc_Name_Title_Case rebuilt as an Expression.
TRANSFORMATION.NAME: cc_Name_Title_Case

TRANSFORMATION.DESCRIPTION: IDQ Labeler lbl_Name_Zero rebuilt as an Expression.
TRANSFORMATION.NAME: mplt_Name_Standardization_Trailing_Num_Removal_lbl_Name_Zero

TRANSFORMFIELD.NAME: out_FName
TRANSFORMFIELD.EXPRESSION: Decode (True, INSTR(FName_lbl,'X0X') >0 AND NOT IS_NUMBER(SUBSTR(FName,LENGTH(LTRIM(RTRIM(FName))),1)), REPLACESTR ( 1, FName, '0', 'o'), --INSTR(FName_lbl,'XX0') >0, --REPLACESTR ( 1, FName, '0', 'o'), FName)

TRANSFORMFIELD.NAME: out_LName
TRANSFORMFIELD.EXPRESSION: Decode (True, INSTR(LName_Lbl,'X0X') >0 AND NOT IS_NUMBER(SUBSTR(Last_Name,LENGTH(LTRIM(RTRIM(Last_Name))),1)), REPLACESTR ( 1, Last_Name, '0', 'o'), --INSTR(LName_Lbl,'XX0') >0, --REPLACESTR ( 1, Last_Name, '0', 'o'), Last_Name)

TRANSFORMFIELD.NAME: out_MName
TRANSFORMFIELD.EXPRESSION: Decode (True, INSTR(MName_lbl,'X0X') >0 AND NOT IS_NUMBER(SUBSTR(Middle_Name,LENGTH(LTRIM(RTRIM(Middle_Name))),1)), REPLACESTR ( 1, Middle_Name, '0', 'o'), --INSTR(MName_lbl,'X0') >0, --REPLACESTR ( 1, Middle_Name, '0', 'o'), --INSTR(MName_lbl,'XX0') >0, --REPLACESTR ( 1, Middle_Name, '0', 'o'), Middle_Name)

TRANSFORMFIELD.NAME: out_FullName
TRANSFORMFIELD.EXPRESSION: Decode (True, INSTR(FullName_lbl,'X0X') >0 AND NOT IS_NUMBER(SUBSTR(Full_Name,LENGTH(LTRIM(RTRIM(Full_Name))),1)), REPLACESTR ( 1, Full_Name, '0', 'o'), --INSTR(FullName_lbl,'XX0') >0, --REPLACESTR ( 1, Full_Name, '0', 'o'), Full_Name)

TRANSFORMATION.DESCRIPTION: IDQ Labeler lbl_Name_Nbr rebuilt as an Expression.
TRANSFORMATION.NAME: mplt_Name_Standardization_Trailing_Num_Removal_lbl_Name_Nbr

TRANSFORMFIELD.NAME: var_FName
TRANSFORMFIELD.EXPRESSION:
RTRIM(LTRIM(
Decode (True, SUBSTR(LTRIM(RTRIM(FName_lbl)),LENGTH(LTRIM(RTRIM(FName_lbl)))-2,2)!= '99' AND SUBSTR(LTRIM(RTRIM(in_FName)),LENGTH(LTRIM(RTRIM(in_FName))),1) = '0',in_FName,
INSTR(FName_lbl,'9') >0, SUBSTR(in_FName,1, INSTR( FName_lbl, '9', 1, 1 )-1), in_FName)
))

TRANSFORMFIELD.NAME: var_LName
TRANSFORMFIELD.EXPRESSION:
RTRIM(LTRIM( Decode (True,
SUBSTR(LTRIM(RTRIM(LName_lbl)),LENGTH(LTRIM(RTRIM(LName_lbl)))-2,2)!= '99' AND SUBSTR(LTRIM(RTRIM(in_LName)),LENGTH(LTRIM(RTRIM(in_LName))),1) = '0',in_LName,
INSTR(LName_lbl,'9') >0, SUBSTR(in_LName,1, INSTR( LName_lbl, '9', 1, 1 )-1),in_LName)
))

TRANSFORMFIELD.NAME: var_MName
TRANSFORMFIELD.EXPRESSION:
RTRIM(LTRIM(
Decode (True, SUBSTR(LTRIM(RTRIM(MName_lbl)),LENGTH(LTRIM(RTRIM(MName_lbl)))-2,2)!= '99' AND SUBSTR(LTRIM(RTRIM(in_MName)),LENGTH(LTRIM(RTRIM(in_MName))),1) = '0',in_LName,
INSTR(MName_lbl,'9') >0, SUBSTR(in_MName,1, INSTR( MName_lbl, '9', 1, 1 )-1),in_MName)
))

TRANSFORMFIELD.NAME: out_FullName
TRANSFORMFIELD.EXPRESSION: LTRIM(RTRIM(var_FName|| IIF(NOT (ISNULL(var_MName) OR var_MName = ''),' ' || LTRIM(RTRIM(var_MName)), '') || ' ' || LTRIM(var_LName)) )
